channel.description: Resources Slides Video Script Hello and welcome to the week 15 announcements for CIS 527 and CC 510 in fall 2025. So we’re almost at the end of the semester, so there’s not a whole lot remaining in this class. Big things to remember is lab 7 is due the end of finals week, which is December 19th, and your final project is due December 19th as well. And then of course, you should be completing your teaching evaluations.
